job_description_info.job_description:
# Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform

**Company:** Halden Pay (fictional name; cross-border business payments)
**Location:** Lisbon, Portugal (hybrid, 3 days per week in the office)
**Team:** Data Platform

## The role

Halden Pay is growing quickly, and data sits at the centre of that plan. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join the Data Platform team. The team builds and runs the shared data platform that analysts, data scientists and product teams rely on, with a focus on reusable frameworks rather than one-off pipelines.

## Responsibilities

- Own the design, build and day-to-day running of the company's central data platform
- Evaluate and introduce new open-source tools where they bring a clear benefit
- Work with data scientists, analytics engineers and BI colleagues to turn their needs into platform features
- Define and enforce data quality standards, governance rules and access policies

## Tech stack

- Cloud: Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE)
- Orchestration and transformation: Airflow, dbt
- Engineering: Python, SQL, Docker, CI/CD, Git

## Requirements

- Experience designing, building and operating production data platforms or cloud data warehouses at scale
- Advanced Python and SQL, including query optimisation on large datasets
- Strong data modelling skills (dimensional modelling; graph modelling is a plus)
- Hands-on experience with Google Cloud or a comparable cloud (managed warehouse, serverless compute, containers)
- Curiosity about new data architecture ideas and open-source practices
- Good professional English; Portuguese is a plus

If you meet most but not all of the points above, you are still welcome to apply.

## Benefits

- Base salary plus annual bonus
- Training and certification budget
- Support for open-source contributions
- Hybrid work from a central Lisbon office

candidate_text.cover_letter:
Dear Corvane Automotive Components Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Test Engineer position in your validation laboratory in Setúbal.

I currently work at Halvik Pumps in Porto as a Mechanical Design Engineer, where I design pump casings and impellers and run structural FEA. Over the last year I have spent more and more time on our performance test bench: I wrote a LabVIEW acquisition program for it that cut test setup time from about two hours to 30 minutes.

Moving from design into testing is a deliberate step for me. I enjoy seeing how a part really behaves, and I would like to bring my design and FEA background to a team that validates products for demanding automotive customers.

I would be glad to relocate to the Setúbal area.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
Tiago Ferrão-Lindqvist

company_info.company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech in the financial-services industry, providing business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance to exporters. Its stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and supporting colleagues across teams, taking responsibility and learning from problems, and simplifying work so it can move quickly for clients.

The company promotes career development through clear career paths, an annual learning budget and departmental mentoring. Most offices use a hybrid model, with three days a week spent together in the office; collaboration and team events are part of its culture across roughly 40 offices. Employee feedback describes a commercially driven environment with friendly colleagues, though onboarding and training can vary between teams. Its culture rating is slightly below that of similarly sized financial-services companies.

Tiago Ferrão-Lindqvist
Data Engineering | Test & Validation Engineering

Setúbal, Portugal | tiago.ferraolindqvist@example.com | +351 555 010 311
linkedin.com/in/tfl-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Mechanical engineer with 12 years of experience in product design, testing and validation, and practical data tooling. Develops Python scripts to process test-rig data, check results against specifications and generate reports, including a nightly tool used by four test engineers. Experienced querying SQL Server test data and building Power BI dashboards for engineering users. Currently developing data engineering knowledge through an online course and personal projects.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Test & Validation Engineer | Corvane Automotive Components | Setúbal
Mar 2019–Present
- Plan and run durability, vibration and climatic tests on seat-adjuster mechanisms across six servo-hydraulic and electric test rigs; prepare test reports for OEM customers.
- Develop Python scripts using pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib and npTDMS to process TDMS and CSV rig files, flag channels outside test specifications and generate report figures. The tool processes approximately 2 GB of data per week and reduced report preparation from about three days to half a day per test.
- Run the reporting tool nightly on a lab PC using Windows Task Scheduler. It writes summary results to an IT-provisioned staging table in the plant’s SQL Server database and is used by four other test engineers.
- Query test results in SQL Server for trend analysis across three product generations.
- Built a Power BI dashboard using the staging table to show pass/fail trends and cycles to failure by product generation; used by about 15 validation and design engineers.
- Correlate test-rig results with FEA in ANSYS Mechanical and lead 8D root-cause analysis on field failures. Proposed a redesigned adjuster rail bracket that reduced warranty returns for that part by 40%.
- Maintain MATLAB/Simulink models of the adjuster drive used to select rig load profiles that match customer duty cycles.
- Trained three apprentices in rig safety and test setup (2022–2024).

Mechanical Design Engineer | Halvik Pumps | Porto
Sep 2014–Feb 2019
- Designed industrial centrifugal-pump casings and impellers in SolidWorks and prepared production drawings with GD&T; owned DFMEA for two product lines.
- Performed structural FEA of pump casings in ANSYS. Supported the change of one casing family from grey cast iron to ductile iron, saving 12% in material cost.
- Supported conversion of the pump performance test bench to a PLC-controlled setup, including changes to setpoints and timers in Siemens TIA Portal alongside the automation engineer.
- Wrote a LabVIEW data-acquisition program for the performance test bench, reducing test setup time from about two hours to 30 minutes.

SELECTED DATA PROJECTS

Bike-sharing Trips API | Personal Learning Project | 2025
- Built a small Flask API over a public bike-sharing dataset loaded into SQLite, with three read-only endpoints.
- Followed a tutorial to run the project using Docker Compose; maintained personal repositories with Git.

Rig Data Processing and Reporting Tool | Corvane Automotive Components | 2021–Present
- Built Python scripts to parse test-rig output, validate channels against test specifications and generate standard report figures.
- Technologies: Python, pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, npTDMS, SQL Server, Windows Task Scheduler.

Test Results Dashboard | Corvane Automotive Components | 2023
- Created a Power BI dashboard showing pass/fail trends and cycles to failure per product generation for validation and design engineers.
- Technologies: Power BI, SQL.

Adjuster Drive Load-Profile Model | Corvane Automotive Components | 2020–Present
- Maintains a MATLAB/Simulink model of the seat-adjuster drive, including motor, gearbox and rail friction, to help select rig load profiles.
- Technologies: MATLAB, Simulink.

EDUCATION
MSc Mechanical Engineering | Sado Valley Polytechnic | 2014
Thesis: Fatigue life prediction of welded brackets under variable-amplitude loading

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Online Data Engineering Course | In progress
Completed 6 of 9 modules.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Data and programming: Python (pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, npTDMS), SQL, MATLAB/Simulink, Flask, SQLite, Excel/VBA
Data reporting and analysis: Power BI, LabVIEW, Minitab, design of experiments (DOE)
Engineering: ANSYS Mechanical, SolidWorks, CATIA V5, GD&T, DFMEA, 8D problem solving
Tools: Git (personal projects), Docker Compose (personal learning project), Windows Task Scheduler

LANGUAGES
Portuguese (native) | English (fluent) | Spanish (good)

Best regards,
Tiago Ferrão-Lindqvist
